title: Dana RS Stats reload data not working
body: in 3.2, the option to reload data from pump DANA RS to get TDD data to display, does not work. Hitting the reload connects with pump but no data is shown in the Stats screen

comments.body: isn't it after fresh install or pump change?
Fresh install, with same pump. Only had to re-pair since it was a fresh install
then older records from pump are ignored .... wait a few days

Stats are generated for the last two days.
Fixed I'd say
